description: exp-067 (Panel Iteration 44) added bonded_substrate_conduction_correction() to lab/thermo_sidecar.py, modeling the CNT-forest root-to-substrate thermal contact resistance R_contact. Every R_contact value this cycle is an analogy-based proxy (r_contact_provenance='analogy_proxy_diagnostic'), NOT a directly-measured root/substrate figure -- WebSearch/WebFetch were barred this cycle, so the dedicated literature search Red Team's own Iteration-40 audit specified was never attempted. The function returns TWO endpoints -- correction_factor_series (worst-case, contact resistance stacks in series beneath the rear-loss channel) and correction_factor_replace_rear (contact replaces the rear-loss channel entirely) -- which diverge materially at high R_contact and disagree about whether the witness-scale (TD-5) margin is at risk at the proposal's own Stress-B test point. IMPORTANT (Phase-5 erratum, Iteration 44 close): the FIRST-shipped correction_factor_replace_rear formula was a passivity-violating normalization error, caught by ELECTROMAGNETISM's Phase-5 review and confirmed by Red Team's Phase-5 final audit -- do NOT cite the original 'replace-rear ~1.1737x' figure; see NOTES.md's own Erratum section for the corrected numbers (Stress B replace-rear margin is ~3.9286x, not ~1.1737x) rather than a hardcoded decimal here, since a second hardcoded number in this description would itself be liable to go stale the same way. Any citation of this cycle's R_contact-corrected numbers must disclose (a) the analogy-proxy provenance, and (b) which endpoint (series vs. replace-rear) is being cited -- citing correction_factor_series alone as 'the' R_contact correction, without the replace-rear endpoint and its Stress-B divergence, is itself a Checkpoint criterion-4-relevant finding at whichever cycle it recurs (per Red Team's own forward tripwire, phase2_redteam_audit.md and phase3_synthesis.md).

exp-063 Phase-5 (Iteration 40, PHOTONICS' own review, phase5_review_photonics.md line 23) claimed the witness-scale ratio L/e-fold is approx 1,900-6,000x, 'close to exact' support for front-surface generation. Corrected at Iteration 44 (exp-067) Phase 2 (PHOTONICS' own catch this cycle) and independently re-derived by Red Team's Phase-2 audit (A2): from exp-061's own committed tau_true=8.2588, thickness=1440nm, MP-5's witness L is constructed as L=tau_true/alpha_real BY CONSTRUCTION, so the self-consistent ratio L/e-fold_real = tau_true ~= 8.26 at every witness point -- NOT 1,900-6,000x. The disputed figure traces to dividing an alpha_real-built L by an alpha_true-built e-fold, mixing two different absorption rates. Median absorption depth is therefore ~8-8.4% of L (inside the '8-12%' band later cited, not the '<0.3%' figure the old ratio implied), not a negligible fraction. Harmless to R_contact's own arithmetic (R_contact enters via h_combined(L), independent of where within L absorption is generated) but load-bearing for any citation of exp-063 Phase-5's own witness-scale generation-location defense. Any future citation of exp-063's phase5_review_photonics.md on this point must carry the corrected tau_true~=8.26/8-12% framing, never the superseded 1,900-6,000x/<0.3% figures.
